_comment: Single source of truth for user-facing error codes and messages. 'messages' covers document (PDF) errors; 'web_messages' covers webpage errors. The engine (Python) and the website (TypeScript) are each tested against this file so their wording can never drift apart. 'ai_messages' covers AI Change Analyst, which only ever explains a completed comparison.

messages.not_pdf: This file isn't a PDF. Choose a file that ends in .pdf and was saved as a PDF.
messages.empty_file: This file is empty. Choose the PDF again, or re-save it and try once more.
messages.file_too_large: This PDF is larger than the current size limit. Choose a smaller file.
messages.too_many_pages: This PDF has more pages than the current page limit. Choose a shorter document.
messages.password_protected: This PDF is password protected. Remove the password in your PDF reader, save a copy, and upload that copy.
messages.corrupted: This PDF appears to be damaged and can't be read. Re-download or re-export it and try again.
messages.no_pages: This PDF has no pages to compare. Choose a different file.
messages.extraction_failed: Unable to read this PDF's contents. Try re-saving it as a new PDF and upload it again.

web_messages.url_not_allowed: This address can't be checked. DiffNexa only reads public web pages over http or https, and some sites ask not to be read automatically.
web_messages.url_unreachable: That page couldn't be reached. Check the address is correct and the site is online, then try again.
web_messages.url_not_html: That address isn't a web page. DiffNexa reads web pages; for a PDF, use PDF Compare instead.
web_messages.page_needs_javascript: This page builds its content in the browser, so DiffNexa can't read it yet. Pages that work today are ones whose text is in the page itself.
web_messages.page_too_large: That page is larger than DiffNexa can read. Try a specific page rather than a very long one.
web_messages.snapshot_mismatch: That saved capture is for a different address. Choose the capture that matches the page you're checking.
web_messages.snapshot_unreadable: That file isn't a DiffNexa capture, or it's damaged. Choose the file you downloaded when you captured the page.
web_messages.fetch_timeout: That page took too long to respond. It may be slow right now, so try again in a moment.
web_messages.engine_unavailable: The service that reads web pages isn't responding right now. Nothing is wrong with the address you entered.
web_messages.bad_request: Something was missing from that request. Enter a web address and try again.

docx_messages.docx_not_docx: That file isn't a Word .docx document. DOCX Compare reads .docx files only.
docx_messages.docx_legacy_doc: That looks like an older Word .doc file. Open it in Word, save it as .docx, then compare again.
docx_messages.docx_macro_enabled: That is a macro-enabled Word file (.docm). For safety, DOCX Compare reads plain .docx files only. Save it as a .docx without macros, then compare again.
docx_messages.docx_encrypted: This document is password protected. Remove the password in Word, then compare again.
docx_messages.docx_unreadable: That file couldn't be read as a Word document. It may be damaged, or not a real .docx file.
docx_messages.docx_too_large: That document is too large to compare. Try a smaller document, or one without large images.
docx_messages.docx_too_complex: That document has more content than DOCX Compare can compare at once. Try comparing a shorter document.
docx_messages.docx_tracked_changes: This document contains tracked changes that haven't been accepted or rejected. Accept or reject them in Word, save, then compare again.
docx_messages.docx_empty_file: That file is empty. Choose the Word document you want to compare.

excel_messages.excel_not_xlsx: That file isn't an Excel .xlsx workbook. Excel Compare reads .xlsx files only.
excel_messages.excel_legacy_xls: That looks like an older Excel .xls file. Open it in Excel, save it as .xlsx, then compare again.
excel_messages.excel_macro_enabled: That is a macro-enabled Excel file (.xlsm). For safety, Excel Compare reads plain .xlsx files only. Save it as a .xlsx without macros, then compare again.
excel_messages.excel_unsupported: That Excel file is saved in a format Excel Compare can't read yet, such as a binary .xlsb workbook or a template. Save it as an ordinary .xlsx workbook, then compare again.
excel_messages.excel_encrypted: This workbook is password protected. Remove the password in Excel, then compare again.
excel_messages.excel_unreadable: That file couldn't be read as an Excel workbook. It may be damaged, or not a real .xlsx file.
excel_messages.excel_too_large: That workbook is too large to compare. Try a smaller workbook, or one without large images.
excel_messages.excel_too_complex: That workbook has more cells or sheets than Excel Compare can show at once. Try comparing a smaller workbook, or only the sheets you need.
excel_messages.excel_no_sheets: That workbook has no worksheets to compare.
excel_messages.excel_empty_file: That file is empty. Choose the Excel workbook you want to compare.

ai_messages.ai_unavailable: AI analysis isn't available right now. Your comparison is complete and is not affected.
ai_messages.ai_bad_request: This comparison couldn't be sent for AI analysis. Run the comparison again, then try once more.
ai_messages.ai_unverified: This comparison couldn't be confirmed as DiffNexa's own result, so it was not sent for AI analysis. Run the comparison again, then try once more.
ai_messages.ai_unsupported: AI analysis isn't available for this kind of comparison.
ai_messages.ai_too_large: This comparison is too large to send for AI analysis. Every change is still listed in the comparison.
ai_messages.ai_timeout: The AI analysis took too long. Your comparison is not affected. Try again in a moment.
ai_messages.ai_failed: The AI service didn't respond properly. Your comparison is not affected. Try again in a moment.
ai_messages.ai_invalid: AI analysis could not be validated against the comparison evidence.
ai_messages.ai_busy: An AI analysis of this comparison is already running.
ai_messages.ai_limit_reached: AI analysis has reached its limit for today. Your comparison is complete and is not affected.
